title: Finalization does not enforce review, dispute and audit-chain readiness gates

original_titles.title: Answer packs, rescore (dry-run), leaderboard admin modes and finalize checklist missing
Rescoring runs and finalization checklist missing

problem: The event transition to finalized is an ordinary organizer status update. Stage release checks stage state but does not block on open review items, unresolved disputes, missing functional test records or a full audit verification result. The finalization checklist/impact preview is not implemented as an enforced server-side gate.
impact: Results may be declared final while score-bearing work is still pending or while audit anomalies exist. Later score changes become harder to explain and undermine competition credibility.

evidence_paths: backend/app/routers/admin.py: admin disputes and audit verify endpoints
verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Create a server-side finalize_preflight query/service that computes open review items, unresolved disputes, queued/running/dead scoring jobs, unprocessed submissions, missing tests and audit verification results for every relevant scope.
Return a structured list of blocking conditions and warnings. The UI may preview it, but the backend must rerun it inside the finalization transaction.
Block finalization while any blocking item remains. Require an explicit override only for owner-approved emergency cases, with two approvers and a mandatory reason.
Persist an immutable finalization record containing the configuration/version hashes, ledger sequence, audit checkpoints, counts and actor approvals.
Add tests with each blocking condition independently and a test that mutating a blocker after preview still prevents finalization.

acceptance_criteria: Finalization fails while any blocking review/dispute/job/audit issue remains.
Successful finalization stores a reproducible snapshot and is idempotent.
There is no API route that bypasses the preflight.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
